body_html:
#poetryport
Seek simplicity
In consumption
That which enters a body
gets ripped from soil

Seek simplicity
in design
Constraint sparks
Creativity

Seek simplicity
In markets
local dollars feed
mouths of friends

Seek simplicity
In community
Rooted in shared values
of impossible visions

Seek simplicity
In solutions
Doing right, easy
Hard to ignore once known.
Knowing what's right?
